🌎 BEYOND THE 956

POLK COUNTY, Fla. — Professional boxer Edgar Berlanga, 29, was arrested October 26 in Polk County, Florida, on one count of felony aggravated battery and one count of misdemeanor battery, according to reports citing court records and the Lakeland Police Department.

The charges stem from an alleged incident on October 18. According to court documents cited by TMZ, Berlanga allegedly struck the mother of his child with a pistol during an argument inside a vehicle. Webb Watch 956 is not naming the woman.

Berlanga appeared in court Tuesday at the Bartow Courthouse, where a judge set his combined bail at $16,000, according to reports. His arraignment is scheduled for 8:45 a.m. on November 17, when he is expected to formally enter a plea.

Berlanga, a super middleweight with a professional record of 24-2 with 19 knockouts, last fought in July, stopping Steven Butler in the seventh round at Madison Square Garden. He is best known for challenging Canelo Alvarez for the WBA, WBC and WBO super middleweight titles in September 2024, losing by unanimous decision. Neither Berlanga nor Zuffa Boxing had publicly commented on the charges as of the reports.

Berlanga has only been charged, not convicted. The charges are allegations, and he is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) Instagram post; Boxing Insider; Boxing Wire.
